description: Pinned AlienMission direct site selection, creation and selected objective UFO conversion. Explicit override, mission-rule and terrain precedence; selected area, player-base replacement, custom deployment, respawn and suppressed conversion. Minimum integer draws and quarter-fraction coordinates; controlled geography, score and deployment collaborators. Follower conversion uses controlled total-unit counts and destination callbacks; unit count semantics pinned to Craft::getNumTotalUnits.
